scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @openavatars/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w openavatars && npm run build -w @openavatars/react
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @openavatars/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.diagnose:svg: npm run build:packages && node --import tsx scripts/diagnose-svg-motion.ts
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run test:package
scripts.release:publish: npm run release:check && npm publish -w openavatars --access public
